title: Session Recap Publishing Lag
dataSources: Campaign sessions (`campaign:session`), NPC ledger (`npc:ledger`), loot drops (`loot:drop`), XP awards (`xp:award`).
app: Tabletop RPG telemetry — virtual-tabletop session logs (Roll20, Foundry VTT), campaign trackers (World Anvil), and XP / loot / NPC ledgers — streamed to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=campaign:session recap_published=yes recap_published_epoch=*
| eval recap_lag_hours=round((recap_published_epoch-session_end_epoch)/3600,1)
| stats avg(recap_lag_hours) as avg_lag_hours, max(recap_lag_hours) as worst_lag_hours by campaign
| sort - avg_lag_hours
description: Measures how quickly after a session the recap or notes are published for the group.
value: Fast recaps preserve details and keep players engaged between sessions, especially in long campaigns.
implementation: Store session end and recap publish timestamps; calculate average and worst recap lag by campaign.
visualization: Table of campaigns with recap lag in hours.
grandmaExplanation: It warns how long it takes to post the recap after a game so the story stays fresh in everyone's head.
